newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish growth seen close to 6.0 pct in 1997/8-OECD.
newsitem.headline: Irish growth seen close to 6.0 pct in 1997/8-OECD.

text.p: Ireland's Gross National Product is expected to remain close to six percent in 1997 and 1998, the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) said on Thursday.
Ireland's strong expansion is expected to generate continued employment gains that could reduce the unemployment rate below 11 percent in 1997, the OECD said in it June economic outlook.
It said this may lead to a slight pick-up in both wage and price inflation.
The OECD warned that there was a risk of a further decline in the saving rate in the context of rising asset prices and improved labour market conditions.
"This would add to demand pressures and increase the risk of inflation," the OECD warned. REUTER CSL/JOS
